reason: Small, targeted change that removes prior IConfigureOptions<KeyManagementOptions> registrations before adding the module-specific one, reducing risk of duplicate/conflicting key management setups across Azure/Redis data protection features, but could subtly affect setups relying on multiple configured options in combination with other modules.
